intro i
apply funext
intro x
split
· intro h
  have h1 : x ∈ f (i + 1) := h
  have h2 : x ∉ partialSups f i := by
    contraposel
    intro h3
    rw [partialSups_def] at h3
    rcases h3 with ⟨j, h4⟩
    have h5 : j ≤ i := h4
    have h6 : j ≠ i := by
      contraposel h5
      intro h7
      rw [h7] at h5
      exact le_antisymm h5 rfl
    have h7 : x ∈ f j := h4
    have h8 : x ∈ f (i + 1) := h1
    have h9 : x ∈ f (i + 1) ∧ x ∈ f j := And.intro h8 h7
    have h10 : x ∈ ⋁ {f j | j ≤ i} := sup_set_mem (insert_subset (singleton_subset_iff.mpr h7) (le_refl i)) h9
    rw [partialSups_def] at h10
    obtain ⟨j', h11⟩ := h10
    have h12 : j' ≤ i := h11
    have h13 : j' = i := by
      contraposel h12
      intro h14
      rw [h14] at h12
      exact le_antisymm h12 rfl
    rw [h13] at h11
    exact h11
  exact h2
· intro h
  have h1 : x ∈ f (i + 1) \ (partialSups f) i := h
  have h2 : x ∈ f (i + 1) := mem_diff.mp h1
  have h3 : x ∉ (partialSups f) i := mem_diff.mpr h1
  have h4 : x ∉ ⋁ {f j | j ≤ i} := by
    contraposel h3
    intro h5
    rw [partialSups_def] at h5
    rcases h5 with ⟨j, h6⟩
    have h7 : j ≤ i := h6
    have h8 : x ∈ f j := h6
    have h9 : x ∈ f (i + 1) := h2
    have h10 : x ∈ f (i + 1) ∧ x ∈ f j := And.intro h9 h8
    have h11 : x ∈ ⋁ {f j | j ≤ i} := sup_set_mem (insert_subset (singleton_subset_iff.mpr h8) (le_refl i)) h10
    rw [partialSups_def] at h11
    obtain ⟨j', h12⟩ := h11
    have h13 : j' ≤ i := h12
    have h14 : j' = i := by
      contraposel h13
      intro h15
      rw [h15] at h13
      exact le_antisymm h13 rfl
    rw [h14] at h12
    exact h12
  exact h4
